opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that // 2 // twice the petitioner has been granted interim bail and after availing the said interim bail periods, he surrendered before the learned trial Court at right time.

opennyai_summary.18_October_2023__decision:
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, period of detention of the petitioner in judicial custody, sentence imposed and the conduct of the petitioner in complying with the earlier interim bail orders, I am inclined to release him on interim bail for a period of three months from the date of release.

Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
List this matter in the week commencing from 29th January 2024.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The appellant-petitioner has been convicted under section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years and to pay a fine of Rs.10,000/- (rupees ten thousand), in default of payment of fine, to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a further period of one year by the learned Sessions Judge, Cuttack in S.T. Learned counsel for the State has produced the report of the Officer in-charge of Baideswar police station, which indicates that during the period of interim bail, the petitioner has not misutilized his liberty.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The report is taken on record.
Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that that the petitioner is in judicial custody for eight years out of ten years of substantive sentence imposed on him by the learned trial Court and twice he has been granted interim bail and after availing the same, he surrendered at right time and there is no chance of early hearing of the appeal in the near future and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Let the appellant-petitioner be released on bail pending disposal of the appeal on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (rupees twenty thousand) with one local solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
